sources.excerpt: Published on September 13, 2006 Crossfire distortion pedal Information Crossfire This high quality Distortion Pedal DST-301 from CROSSFIRE is housed in a rugged heavy duty metal casing. This MXR style pedal features Sturdy Footswitch and control knobs. Operates on either battery or Standard 9 volt centre negative Boss style Power Supply (Not Supplied). This pedal delivers a warm rich and detailed distortion while retaining the sonic integrity of your instrument. Built to last, this little baby is virtually indestructible and will definitely go the distance.
